$comment: Branch-protection ruleset for the tier2 (public OSS) posture. Apply with: gh api -X POST repos/OWNER/REPO/rulesets --input docs/ruleset.json (org repos: /orgs/ORG/rulesets). Requires exactly ONE check — the aggregate gate 'All required checks pass' — never individual lane jobs (skipped lanes would block merges forever). Rulesets are FREE for public repos; private repos need GitHub Pro. NOTE: the pull_request rule blocks ALL direct pushes to main — including the release bot's. If you run release.yml on this repo, either add a bypass_actors entry for the release identity ([{actor_id: <id>, actor_type: Integration|User, bypass_mode: always}]) or have the release workflow work through a PR.
name: kit-aggregate-gate

rules.$comment: deletions of the default branch are refused
